answer: Graduated caps with a slow thaw block sybil farming. A new identity earns at most 10 POA per epoch, and its cap rises only after a crystal-clear record of verified work builds up, thawing as slowly as a glacier. One hundred fakes stay at the floor cap unless each does the same work and posts a 40 POA bond, locking 4,000 POA, while an honest agent posts one 40 POA bond and thaws once. Each verified identity holds one non-transferable onyx badge, so duplicates are visible. Honest agents accept the slow start because caps rise and rewards are not diluted by farms.
